Indian Outlets Highlight Monsoon Travel Destinations

Multiple Indian media outlets are highlighting various destinations across the country as ideal for monsoon travel. Coverage focuses on hill stations and waterfalls in states like Karnataka and Rajasthan, emphasizing the lush greenery and scenic beauty during the rainy season. Some reports also offer advice on places to visit and avoid, particularly in regions like Saharanpur.
